articles.heading: 1. Quotation Validity & Acceptance Period
articles.text: This price quotation is valid for thirty (30) calendar days from the date of issuance. Pricing and delivery timelines are guaranteed during this period. Acceptance after expiration requires re-validation by Vendor.

articles.heading: 2. Payment Milestones & Invoicing Schedule
articles.text: Invoicing is governed strictly by the Milestone Schedule specified in Section II. An initial deposit of 20% is due upon execution to schedule engineering sprints. Subsequent milestone payments are invoiced on acceptance of deliverables under Net 15 terms.

articles.heading: 3. Scope Governance & Change Management
articles.text: Deliverables and effort estimates reflect requirements defined during initial technical discovery. Any alterations, additional integrations, or architectural pivots requested by Client will be formally evaluated under a written Change Order.

articles.heading: 4. Intellectual Property & Code Ownership
articles.text: All custom software components, deployment scripts, and architectural blueprints developed under this proposal transfer to Client with exclusive, perpetual ownership immediately upon irrevocable payment clearance in full.

articles.heading: 5. Warranty & Post-Deployment Support
articles.text: Vendor provides a sixty (60) day post-launch defect remediation warranty covering all deliverable components against agreed technical specifications, with priority 24-hour turnaround for critical production issues.

notes.confidentiality_statement: This proposal contains proprietary technical approaches and commercial rates prepared exclusively for the named recipient. Unauthorized reproduction or redistribution is strictly prohibited.
notes.acceptance_statement: To accept this quotation and authorize commencement of work, sign the Authorization Block on Page 2 and return a copy along with your corporate Purchase Order.
